name: omniorder-saas-platform
description: Multi-Tenant B2B SaaS Order Management Platform with Apache Kafka and Database Performance Optimization

scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix frontend run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.cpSync('frontend/dist', 'dist', {recursive: true});"
